summary.text: Eric Hoffman is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Belknap 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, he replaced Charlie St. Clair on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Eric Hoffman said he is a licensed professional engineer in New Hampshire and lives in Laconia.

An earlier version of his survey response said he received a bachelor's degree in Electro-Mechanical Engineering from Penn State University and designs HVAC systems for healthcare facilities, educational campuses and commercial buildings.
Hoffman was a Democratic candidate for Belknap 5 in 2022 as well, advancing from the September 13, 2022 primary but not winning one of the four seats in the November 8, 2022 general election.
In his 2022 survey, he listed supporting public schools, reproductive and voting rights, and environmental and energy policy as his key campaign messages.
